Subject: Supplier onboarding — VAT handling & PO expectations

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this — we (Aurelius Imports BV, NL) are starting the onboarding to supply logistics and ICS reporting services to Redwood for EU orders. Before we upload our documents to your vendor portal we need to confirm a couple of tax / invoicing details so our billing team issues compliant invoices. Quick questions: 

- Do you expect us to charge Dutch VAT on our monthly invoices to Redwood, or will the reverse-charge rule apply? Redwood is a US-headquartered company — if you have an EU VAT registration please share the number so we can apply the appropriate treatment.
- Does Redwood require a PO number on every invoice? If so, will you provide a PO in advance each month or per shipment?
- Any special line items Redwood requires (e.g., cost center, project code, contract reference) to trigger automated payment?

We have the following attachments ready: VAT registration certificate and a sample invoice. We'll upload them to your portal once you confirm the preferred flow.

Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — VAT handling & PO expectations

Hi Helena — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. Helpful. A couple of clarifications from our side so we can get finance to map this correctly: 

1) Redwood legal entity contracting for this work is Redwood Inference, Inc. (US). We do not currently have an EU VAT registration under that legal entity. If Redwood were to register in the EU in future we will notify partners.

2) For now, please treat invoices to Redwood Inference, Inc. as supplied to a non-EU customer. In practice: if Dutch law treats the supply to a non-EU corporate customer as outside the scope of Dutch VAT (or zero-rated), please present your invoice without VAT and reference your VAT number + a short note such as: 
   "Supplier VAT: NL813456789B01 — Supply to non-EU customer (outside scope / reverse charge not applicable to supplier)"

   If your local rules require you to charge VAT regardless, mark the VAT amount separately and we will route to finance for review. Note: Redwood cannot reclaim EU VAT unless we have a local VAT registration.

3) Yes — we require a PO number on every invoice for AP automation. Procurement will create a monthly PO per vendor agreement (we can do a rolling monthly PO or one per shipment depending on what we've agreed contractually). Please include the PO number in the invoice header and on every page.

4) Required invoice fields for smooth payment: invoice number, invoice date, supplier legal name and VAT number, Redwood PO number, line-level descriptions of services, bank details (IBAN / SWIFT), and a remittance email.

I've attached our short PO requirements checklist to this email (redwood-po-requirements.pdf). Can you upload your VAT certificate and a draft invoice to our vendor portal (link below) and copy Neha so Finance has the docs? Once Neha confirms, Procurement will issue the first PO (we aim to have the PO issued before the first invoice).

Portal upload: https://vendor.redwood.com/onboard

Next steps: 
- Helena: upload VAT cert + sample invoice to portal and confirm whether you will charge VAT or present invoices VAT-free under Dutch rules.
- Neha: will confirm any finance-side tolerances (payment terms, whether net 30 or net 45) and whether we need a local tax representative.

Thanks — talk soon.

Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Soojin / Neha,

Thanks — we uploaded the two files to your portal and included the VAT cert and a sample invoice. Summary from our tax team: 

- Company VAT: NL813456789B01 (confirmed).
- Nature of supplies: primarily cross-border digital and logistics services to a US corporate customer. Under Dutch VAT law the supply to a non-EU business is typically outside the scope of VAT. Therefore our standard practice is to issue invoices without VAT and include a reference to the VAT number and the legal basis ("supply to non-EU customer — outside scope of Dutch VAT").
- Sample invoice (Aurelius-sample-invoice-PO12345.pdf) shows the PO field, bank details (IBAN NL92ABNA0123456789), and a statement: "No VAT charged — customer outside EU."

If Redwood prefers us to display a VAT line and then mark it as zero (0%) we can do that too — please confirm the exact text you'd like for your AP automation.

Attached: Aurelius-VAT-Certificate-2026.pdf, Aurelius-sample-invoice-PO12345.pdf

Helena

Thanks Helena — got the uploads and the sample invoice. A few final confirmations from Finance so we can close onboarding: 

On Sun, May 7, 2026 at 08:45 +02:00 helena.vandijk@aurelius-imports.nl wrote:
> - Company VAT: NL813456789B01 (confirmed).
> - Nature of supplies: primarily cross-border digital and logistics services to a US corporate customer. Under Dutch VAT law the supply to a non-EU business is typically outside the scope of VAT. Therefore our standard practice is to issue invoices without VAT and include a reference to the VAT number and the legal basis ("supply to non-EU customer — outside scope of Dutch VAT").

Confirmed: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity) does not have an EU VAT number and will not supply an EU VAT ID. Accordingly, Finance's preferred invoice format is either: 

A) No VAT line visible, with a text note: 
   "Supplier VAT: NL813456789B01 — Supply to non-EU customer; outside scope of Dutch VAT."

OR

B) VAT line present but set at 0% with a note: 
   "0% VAT — supply to non-EU customer (Redwood Inference, Inc. — non-EU entity)."

Either is acceptable. Important AP/ERP requirements: 
- Invoice must list our Redwood PO number in the header (Procurement will issue PO: PO-RWD-2026-3487) — we will provide this PO to you before the first invoice due date.
- Bank details and invoice remittance email must be present exactly as in your sample.
- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date unless otherwise agreed in a signed SOW.

If at any time Aurelius believes Dutch VAT must be charged by law, please produce an explicit VAT calculation on the invoice; Redwood will then escalate for tax review but cannot guarantee VAT recovery without a local VAT registration.

We will proceed to create PO-RWD-2026-3487 and share it via Procurement within two business days. After you confirm which invoice format (A or B above) you'll use, we will mark the vendor record active.

Thanks — welcome aboard.
